summary: Fixed two floor-editor bugs reported right after dragging an appliance in from the map's tray: picking a drawing tool while carrying a pending placement silently abandoned it, and the generic crosshair cursor gave no clue what was being placed. Only the Select branch of the canvas pointer handler ever placed a pick - every drawing tool (wall/room/round/door/window/stairs/platform/parking/erase) returned from its own branch first, so a click with a drawing tool active drew a wall instead of dropping the marker, and the carried pick appeared to vanish. floor_editor.js now forces the tool back to Select and clears any in-progress draft as soon as a pick is pending (a useEffect on the pick itself, not the drop, since a pick can also arrive with the editor already open, from the side palette or a second drag), disables every drawing-tool button while carrying something (Select stays enabled) with a new tooltip (grid.lockedWhilePlacing: 'Finish placing first, or cancel it') explaining the lock, and swaps the canvas cursor from a plain crosshair to the pending marker's own icon - drawn as an inline SVG data URI from the shared icon set, a white halo pass under the accent-blue icon so it reads over a plan of any colour, 24px with a centred hotspot. One new i18n key (grid.lockedWhilePlacing) was added to all four dicts (en/ms/zh/ar).
compatibility: Frontend-only interaction fix inside one component; no API, schema, or config changes. The placing/drop flow itself (onDrop, palette pick, ISiteService.AddPlacement) is unchanged - this only prevents a drawing tool from intercepting the click meant to place a pending pick, and improves the cursor while one is pending. No operator or migration action required. Verified live on a throwaway install: with the editor idle all 9 tools are selectable; picking from the palette forces Select active, disables the 8 drawing tools with the explaining tooltip, and sets the canvas cursor to the marker's own icon (confirmed the browser actually decoded the data URI at 24x24, since a malformed one silently falls back to crosshair and would look identical in a screenshot); cancelling re-enables every tool. Build, go test, and npm run lint:undef clean; all four i18n dicts hold an identical key set.
